# Our Partners 

The Open University has a diverse network of partners, including institutions across UK, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. Once approved, institutions offer Open University validated awards, granted under the University's UK Royal Charter. These have complete parity of esteem with the awards offered throughout UK higher education.

Our partner institutions are:
